| #31608 | closed by the merge (`Fixes #31608`) |

Landed:
- Autonumber issuing in the SQL driver no longer races on a missing counter row: a plain read, then an idempotent seed (conflict-ignore on Postgres/SQLite, a no-op merge on MySQL), then `FOR UPDATE`, then the increment. Two concurrent first inserts get distinct numbers.
- On MySQL a deadlock (`ER_LOCK_DEADLOCK`, 1213) retries the whole issue, at most 5 times, and only when the driver owns the transaction; a caller-owned transaction gets the error unchanged.
- OQ1 (a unique index on the counter key) was not added here: #13894 / #14904 already cover it.
